test_cases.path_step: A user (Teacher or Student) creates a new password by entering and confirming a new password on the password reset page, ensuring it meets the defined strength rules.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 2: USER ACCOUNT RECOVERY SCENARIO
test_cases.test_case_title: Set New Password with Valid Credentials
test_cases.pre_condition: A user (Teacher or Student) has initiated the password reset process, has received a unique, time-sensitive password recovery link via email, and has successfully accessed the secure password reset page on the FullTeaching platform using that link. The system is online and able to process password reset requests.
test_cases.expected_result: After entering and confirming a valid new password that meets the defined strength rules, the system updates the user's credentials, displays a success message, and redirects the user to the login page. The password reset is successful.
test_cases.post_condition: The user's password has been successfully updated, and they are redirected to the Login Page, ready to log in with their new password. The password recovery link is invalidated.

test_steps.step: Open the secure password reset page via the recovery link (simulated).
Enter 'NewSecurePass123!' into the 'new password input field'.
Enter 'NewSecurePass123!' into the 'confirm new password input field'.
